title: Asean urged to boost food security amid risks

blocks.text: GENEVA, Switzerland — The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) should explore alternative mechanisms to ensure regional food security amid potential disruptions arising from geopolitical events, according to the International Trade Center (ITC). ITC Executive Director Pamela Coke-Hamilton said ASEAN has the collective power to withstand future global supply shocks, depending on how much it is willing to invest in strengthening its food security measures.
